_comment: Keycap-sized forms of the value names the firmware reports for constant parameters (behavior_bt.c, behavior_outputs.c, ...). '{p2}' is replaced by param2, which those behaviors use for the profile index. A newline splits the label over two lines, which is how the two Clear commands are told apart at a glance. Unlisted names fall back to initials, so a firmware that adds a value still shows something.
